items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs. Panthers after missing all practice this week; also placed Will Shipley on IR.
items.why: Missed all week of practice with hamstring
items.implication: Major RB downgrade for PHI offense; backup workload spike expected
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB snaps and carries expand significantly in PHI backfield

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out for Week 6 vs Rams; will rest ailing ankle for long-term healing.
items.implication: ARI RB committee or other backs elevate; McBride/Brissett volume stable
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining ARI RBs

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) for Sunday at Cleveland; no practice all week, Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Ankle sprain, missed every practice this week
items.implication: Huntley starts; Flowers still viable but Andrews/Ravens pass game downgraded
items.opportunity: Backup QB and short-yardage TE/RB usage may shift

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7, investigation ongoing.
items.implication: Jacobs returns to GB backfield ROS value boost starting W7
items.opportunity: Potential lead back snaps/carries resume Week 7+

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown listed questionable; Berry notes possible return this week providing relief for fantasy managers.
items.implication: If active, immediate WR1/2 upside in NE; monitor final status

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially questionable after another full practice; potential return from hamstring.
items.implication: Likely to play; boosts CHI pass catchers like Odunze/Burden/Moore if active
items.opportunity: QB and WR/TE snap/target upgrade if starts

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) for Sunday vs Patriots; third straight miss, remains week-to-week.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues workhorse role with high snap/carry share
items.opportunity: Allen 85%+ snaps, majority carries/targets in recent games without Hall

items.text: Cardinals traded Marvin Harrison Jr. to HOU; ETR discusses fantasy fallout with Bourne potentially earning more targets in ARI.
items.implication: MHJ role in HOU offense TBD; ARI WR targets redistribute (Bourne upgrade)
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining ARI WRs like Wilson; MHJ new opportunity in HOU

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation and is clear for Sunday at KC.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected vs KC

items.text: Berry loves Mike Evans as WR4 vs WSH due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak WSH pass defense
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start with high target upside
items.opportunity: Red-zone and volume in favorable spot

items.text: Berry loves Drake London as WR6 vs CHI citing bankable usage.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets secure even if Penix starts

items.text: Berry loves Kyren Williams as RB5 vs ARI for elite recent usage and soft run defense.
items.why: Elite usage + leaking ARI run D
items.implication: RB1 upside with volume and TD potential

items.text: Berry hates Jaylen Waddle as WR28 vs SEA due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Ugly SEA matchup + shaky QB situation
items.implication: Fade/sit in most formats this week

items.text: Berry hates Bo Nix as QB23 vs SEA; historically timid and faces toughest pass D.
items.why: Timid play + elite SEA pass defense
